A lab, not proven noise cancellation. Inverted playback can increase noise or cause feedback. Browser latency prevents reliable room-wide cancellation. Start at low volume; stop if sound grows.

01 Microphones

Each mic starts at 100% (no software boost). Multiple selected mics are averaged; system microphone sensitivity is controlled in your sound settings.
